subject: Compliance discovery: telemetry & tracking scope — follow-up and timeline
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Petrova <elena.petrova@sablefinancial.com>, DPO Team <dpo@sablefinancial.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap: telemetry, SOC 2 status & next steps

Hi Elena / DPO team —

Thanks again for taking time this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side so we’re aligned: 

1) SOC 2 / compliance posture
- Redwood is SOC 2 Type II in-scope for production inference and control plane (we maintain the cert through an annual audit). Rachel will attach our cert summary and provide the auditor point-of-contact for you.

2) GDPR / HIPAA considerations
- Our hosted offering supports data residency controls and logging/audit exports. We do not index customer input for model training unless contractually enabled. For HIPAA, we support BAAs on dedicated/private deployments — we can outline the flow.

3) Telemetry & tracking (what you asked about)
- Two categories: internal product telemetry (latency/cost metrics, anonymized usage) and end-user-facing tracking on console/docs pages (cookies, analytics). We propose a short questionnaire to capture the explicit telemetry endpoints you need details on.

4) Vendor Security Questionnaire (VSQ)
- Per your ask, I’ve attached a VSQ template pre-filled with basic info. If you prefer, we can import into your questionnaire tool (OneTrust / Koala) — tell me which one.

Next steps (proposed):
- Rachel to share SOC 2 summary + short telemetry dataflow diagram (EOD today).
- Elena / DPO to send back the VSQ with any priority questions flagged (we’ll target 3 business days for answers).
- Connor to schedule a focused follow-up (30m) with Security Ops and product PMs to walk telemetry endpoints and retention controls.

Would 11:00am PT on Thursday work for a 30-min follow-up?

Thanks — I’ll drop the attachments in a separate email.

Cheers,
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0189

Attachments: vendor-security-questionnaire-Sable-20261214.xlsx (filled basic fields)

From: Elena Petrova <elena.petrova@sablefinancial.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: DPO Team <dpo@sablefinancial.com>, Security Ops <security-ops@sablefinancial.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: telemetry, SOC 2 status & next steps

Hi Connor —

Thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifying questions before we distribute the VSQ internally: 

- When you say "product telemetry (anonymized usage)", can you list the exact data points collected by the hosted console (e.g., request IDs, IPs, prompt snippets, model selection, token counts)? We need to verify DPIA scope.
- On the docs site: do you set any third-party analytics cookies beyond a Google Analytics pageview? Any embedded widgets that load third-party resources?
- For SOC 2 evidence: can you share the auditor contact and the last audit date? We typically ask for a gap analysis for any production change in the last 12 months.

We’ve started the internal intake and will try to return the VSQ with high-priority items flagged by EOD Wednesday.

Elena
Elena Petrova
Head of Data Protection, Sable Financial
elena.petrova@sablefinancial.com

Hi Elena —

Quick responses and I attached a short diagram and the SOC 2 summary PDF for your intake team. Highlights: 
- SOC 2 Type II report: last audit period ended 2026-06-30; auditor: Meridian Assurance (contact: audits@meridianassurance.com). We can provide a redacted report under NDA — let me know if you want that.
- Telemetry collected on hosted console: request ID, model id/variant, request timestamp, token counts (input/output), anonymized latency percentile buckets, and error codes. We do NOT persist raw prompt text in aggregate telemetry unless a customer enables "diagnostics"; plaintext inputs are only stored in encrypted request logs for 30 days by default for support/debugging (customer-configurable).
- IP addresses are captured in access logs (retention configurable) to support security investigations; we can provide an export if requested.
- Docs site: we use a minimal analytics snippet (self-hosted Matomo) and only load third-party resources for the embedded API examples (sandbox frames that call the hosted API). No advertising/tracking pixels.

Attachments included: redwood-telemetry-dataflows-v1.pdf (diagram), SOC2-summary-2026.pdf (redacted summary), sample-kv-cache-diagram.png

If Sable needs a deeper dive, happy to set a 45-min technical session with our infra/observability PMs.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Head of Security Engineering, Redwood Inference
